readerEvidence.summary: Direct single-pass Astra reading of all 7 problem and 23 matching official solution pages. Six independent tasks, printed labels 9.7, 9.8, 10.7, 10.8, 11.7, 11.8; numbered instructions/assumptions retained within their tasks. All solution prose, derivations and grading retained. Street photograph referenced as separate photographic paper in the questions restored from the matching official solution page 1. Full 2023 inventory inspected: other theoretical, blitz, regional and camp documents are different rounds; no additional matching practical supplement is catalogued. No missing source content identified. Source defects preserved: problem 9.7 typo «межу»; solution 9.8 rubric calls inverse ratio rA/rB=1.887; solution 10.8 defines negative K then prints positive K algebra; its rubric calls vR an angular speed. Solution 11.7 prints T rather than T2 in one displayed orbital relation. Solution 11.8 log-speed graph says km/s although numerical logarithms use m/s; printed gravity unit is m/s^-2. These are not silently corrected. No independent model checker.
